scope: Exploratory depth extension on the same six-facility, six-customer FLP42 instance and complete 12-step annealing target. Prior hardware outcomes are known. Refit two through 22 native layers and retain archived controls and fits; actual executed CZ depth must not exceed 200. No new claim is added to the manuscript until independent hardware confirmation is complete.
fitting: Block coordinate AQC-Tensor state-fidelity fitting. Cache the MPS input before a two-layer block and the target transformed by the inverse fixed suffix. Optimize the block using the library explicit MPS gradient with the cached input state. Evaluate updates against the complete bond-512 target and retain only improvements. Validate final full circuit at bonds 256 and 512. Two seeded starts, with both previous fits and exact identity extensions retained as candidates. Numerical MPS convergence is not an exact certificate.
selection: Best numerically verified fidelity per layer count, retaining original product and two-layer preparations as controls. Use two new randomized screening blocks to select a native circuit by measured feasibility; tie break by fidelity and then smaller actual CZ depth. Freeze before independent confirmation. Screening counts are descriptive and are excluded from confirmation effects.
inference: Separate exploratory six-test Holm family for selected native versus full annealing, original product and original shallow AQC, for feasibility and optimum probability. Use independent confirmation blocks, conditional exact tests, pointwise block MOVER intervals and conservative CP sensitivity intervals. Do not pool with the original FLP42 experiment or treat depths as independent problem instances.
execution: All methods on ibm_rensselaer Nighthawk revision 1, on the original physical patch. Recheck live edges, processor and ISA; save calibration, hashes, intent, receipt and raw counts. No feasibility repair, postselection or automatic resubmission. Raw execution without twirling or dynamical decoupling. A missing or ambiguous job receipt requires explicit reconciliation.
